Enjoying Nude Amore

The ritual

How to serve

Chill to 6–8°C — cold enough to refresh, never so cold it mutes the perfume. Pour into a white-wine glass or a generous flute, fill two-thirds, and let the mousse settle.

How to store

Keep it somewhere cool and dark, away from heat and light. Prosecco is made for freshness, not the cellar — enjoy within a year or two. Once open, reseal, keep cold, finish within a day or two.

How to pair

Endlessly versatile — the classic Italian aperitivo. Its bright acidity and fine bubble cut through salt, fat and spice alike, flattering almost anything on the table.

At The Table

Food pairings

Brut
Oysters, shellfish and sushi, fried calamari, salty aperitivo snacks.
Extra Dry
Prosciutto e melone, soft cheeses, light pasta, weekend brunch.
Dry
Fruit tarts and pastries, blue cheese, gently spiced Asian dishes.
Rosé
Cured salmon, tuna tartare, strawberries, summer salads.
